features.name: Nullable Unit values and safe calls returning Unit
features.scope: Nullable Unit descriptors, safe-call null and Unit singleton results, Java void effects, lazy receiver and argument evaluation, assertion/Elvis paths, callbacks and generic calls.
restrictions: Nonnullable Unit backing fields remain outside this supported subset.

features.name: Volatile backing fields
features.scope: Canonical kotlin.jvm.Volatile and import aliases on mutable top-level, class, constructor, object and companion backing fields; correct JVM volatile/static ownership and SOURCE retention.
restrictions: Other annotations requiring companion property splitting and JvmField combinations remain bounded.

features.name: Compiled inline monitor instructions
features.scope: JVM verification frames for ordinary resolved compiled inline monitorenter/monitorexit instructions; nested/reentrant ownership and release on callbacks, throws and conditional nonlocal returns.
restrictions: Generic Nothing inference for unconditional abrupt lambda bodies remains outside the tested subset.

features.name: Mutable properties during class method result inference
features.scope: Retain mutable constructor and body property assignments while inferring source class expression-body results; custom setter effects and rejected val assignments are checked.
restrictions: This change covers source class inference; it does not claim new object or top-level mutation inference.

VerseItem.remaining_boundary: Android migration nullability annotation on Integer.parseInt parameter

limitations: No Android runtime or full-app compatibility claim. Earlier failed/superseded development reports are preserved. The inference source archive is committed base 380dfb2ff plus the recorded inference.patch.
